title: How to write a cold email with AI, one prospect at a time
seoTitle: Cold email with AI: template and follow-ups
description: Write a cold email with AI that's short, true and personal. Get a research method, a cold email template, follow-ups, prompts and the legal basics.
lede: A good cold email is short, focused on the reader and built on one genuine reason for writing. AI can research and draft it quickly, while you verify the facts and personally approve every message. This guide gives you the method, a reusable template, three prompts, a follow-up plan and the legal basics.
